revision_history.rev1: Called 22 names 'ghosts from an old roster'. Wrong mechanism - retracted.
revision_history.rev2: Claimed they were LIVE workers DELETED on 2026-09-11, inferred from fleet_probe_log HTTP status flipping 200 -> 404. THIS IS FALSIFIED - see rev4_retraction.
revision_history.rev3: Added the wontfix adjudications, the #746 hazard, and the alert-ledger purge caveat.
revision_history.rev4: RETRACTS the rev2/rev3 cutover mechanism. The 200 -> 404 flip was a PROBE TRANSPORT change, not a deletion. The 55-worker roster is NOT authoritative. Corrects the liveness method and flags an unjustified D1 deletion.

rev4_retraction.what_was_claimed: That ~22 workers were deleted on 2026-09-11 between 09:19Z and 16:45Z, inferred from per-name HTTP status in fleet_probe_log flipping from 200 to 404.
rev4_retraction.line_1_liveness: cloud_ops_events grouped by job shows workers writing to D1 TODAY: qnfo-pipeline-ops n=978 last 2026-09-13T14:31:19.094Z; qnfo-fleet-advisor n=376 last 2026-09-13T14:21:14.547Z; qnfo-register-guard n=7 last 2026-09-13T04:30:44.175Z. A deleted worker cannot write.
rev4_retraction.line_2_transport: The probed URL is IDENTICAL in both outcomes: https://<name>.q08.workers.dev/health. Only the transport differs. qnfo-pipeline-ops: transport=http ok=1 status=200 n=13 last 2026-09-10T12:21:46; transport=cf-api-list ok=1 status=200 n=131 last 2026-09-11T16:30:50; transport=http ok=0 status=404 n=68 last 2026-09-12T09:15:45. Same shape for qnfo-fleet-advisor, qnfo-register-guard, qnfo-auditor, fleet-executor. The 404 is the documented SVC-BINDING-1 artifact: same-account workers.dev fetches return 404 at the edge from inside a Worker.
rev4_retraction.corrected_cause: The 404s began when the dashboard switched probe transport from cf-api-list to http - a code change, not a fleet change.

corrected_liveness_method.rule: Liveness CANNOT be measured from probe status. A 404 conflates 'worker gone' with 'transport cannot reach it'. Liveness must be measured from D1 writes by the worker itself (cloud_ops_events.job, or the worker's own tables).
corrected_liveness_method.implication: Every roster reconciliation in this fleet should use write-evidence, not probe-evidence.

live_cf_scripts.evidence: qnfo-pipeline-ops, qnfo-fleet-advisor and qnfo-register-guard are live (write-evidence, 2026-09-13) yet absent from this list and from service_registry. Matches closed ticket #729 PIPELINE-OPS-INVISIBLE.

unjustified_deletion_to_disclose.what: 15 fleet_deploy_state scanerr keys deleted (changes:6 then changes:9) on the stated ground that probe history proved those workers were deleted on 2026-09-11.
unjustified_deletion_to_disclose.why_wrong: That ground is false per rev4_retraction. Notably qnfo-idea-factory was in the deleted set, yet worker-health probed https://ideas.qnfo.org/health with status 200 as recently as 2026-09-13T03:05:38Z.
unjustified_deletion_to_disclose.impact: Bounded and self-healing - these are scanner bookkeeping keys that the scanner regenerates - but the deletion should not have been made on that justification.

auto_close_predicate_defect.mechanism: qnfo-backlog-exec's health-availability branch closes a ticket when the TARGET re-probes PASS. For a ticket whose subject is 'the monitor reports X incorrectly', the re-probe passes precisely BECAUSE the monitor is wrong. #693 was closed 7.2 minutes after filing on this path.
auto_close_predicate_defect.source: QNFO/qnfo-workers qnfo-backlog-exec/worker.js sha fc0eb745, 31,806 B, VERSION 1.3.0
auto_close_predicate_defect.predicate: const isHealthAvailability = /health|heartbeat|availability|endpoint down|is down|reachable/i.test(title) && /health|availability|reachable|down/i.test(title); if (name && isHealthAvailability) { const pLog = await probeHealthyViaLog(env, name); if (p.ok) close; }
auto_close_predicate_defect.deployed_proof: issue_ledger holds 183 rows resolved with note 'auto-resolved v1.2.8: ...', most recent 2026-09-13T14:04:10.217Z, so v1.2.8+ is executing; the branch predates v1.2.0 per the file's own v1.2.0 comment.
sub_defects: The branch violates the file's own v1.1.0 note: 'never auto-close on generic /health alone - a worker can be up while its failing endpoint is broken.'
The v1.2.2 mitigation for SVC-BINDING-1 (use fleet_probe_log as evidence) is what makes the SVC-BINDING-1 ticket auto-close.
A second wrong path closes on probe FAILURE when /orphan|bogus|does not exist/i matches the title (explains closed #497).
workerTarget searches title+description but isHealthAvailability searches the title only.
